scope: Kueue v0.20.6 ClusterQueue quota admission for one isolated team namespace. The only accounted resource is a synthetic integer example.com/usd-per-hour request, with one declared unit standing for a fictional whole USD/hour of requested rate and a five-unit cap. The rate comparison uses raw Workloads and creates no Job, Pod, GPU allocation, device request, cloud budget, invoice, charge, billing record, external notification, job suspension, or scale-down. It does not measure actual GPU use, provider prices, cumulative spend, a budget window, or production tenant ownership/RBAC. A separate synthetic budget signal exercises scoped native Job suspension, Deployment scale-down and an unrelated allowed workload.

checks.claim: The permissive queue can reserve six declared units above the five-unit target
The same request remains pending specifically because the target cap is full
Releasing a reservation admits the waiting request with no fixture Pods
A synthetic budget threshold without the actuator leaves both workloads running
An approaching threshold yields an advisory and stale observations do not trigger workload actions
A current threshold observation suspends the named Job and reduces the named Deployment to zero
The actual API refuses actuator access to an unrelated Deployment and its Pod remains ready
